name: OpenAI
tagline: Model, embeddings, realtime, image, and agent APIs.
shortDescription: A broad AI platform with documented REST APIs, SDKs, model pricing, request IDs, and usage controls.
agentSummary: Agents can call chat, responses, embeddings, image, audio, realtime, and tool-oriented APIs with clear request and response schemas.
bestFor: Model calls, embeddings, speech, image generation, evals, and agent backends.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Production agents need budget controls, data-handling review, prompt-injection defenses, and model-specific evals. Model behavior, costs, rate limits, data retention, and safety policies can change by model and account tier; use evals, spend caps, and data controls for sensitive workloads. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Store credentials outside source control and use least-privilege scopes, short-lived tokens, or restricted keys where the product supports them.
pricingSummary: Public per-model usage pricing with separate input, output, cached, and media dimensions.
authModel: API keys, project keys, organization/project scoping, and request IDs for support.
accountCreation: Self-serve signup; paid usage requires billing setup.
browserSupport: Dashboard is useful for keys, usage, logs, evals, and project setup.

capabilities.detail: REST API covers model, embedding, realtime, image, and audio workflows.
API reference and guides include curl examples, SDKs, request IDs, and model-specific notes.
Pricing is public by model and modality.
Self-serve signup; paid usage requires billing setup.
Dashboard is useful for keys, usage, logs, evals, and project setup.
Agents can test in separate projects and enforce usage limits before production rollout.
